en-US.summary: Live FC Barcelona scores with an aesthetic scoreboard on your Echo Show
examplePhrases: Alexa ask barca live score for the score
Alexa ask barca live score when barca plays next
en-US.name: Barca Live Score
en-US.description: Tracks FC Barcelona's matches and shows a live, animated scoreboard on your Echo Show while the match is on. Ask for the live score, or ask when Barca plays next.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say 'Alexa, open barca live score' to launch. Say 'what's the score' during or after launch to get the live match state.
